app_recommendations: Acknowledge the divergence between the FDA safety guideline (145°F) and culinary medium doneness (125°F to 130°F): advise users that resting salmon for 3 minutes allows carryover heat to finish cooking while keeping the interior succulent and moist.

For crispy-skin pan searing, mandate two non-negotiable steps in the app: (1) drying the skin thoroughly with paper towels, and (2) applying gentle spatula pressure during the first 30 seconds of searing to keep skin flat against the pan.

In sheet-pan and skillet recipes with starch components (potatoes, rice), enforce staggered cooking: cook the starch first, then add salmon during the final 12 to 15 minutes to prevent overcooking the fish.
Caution against covering crispy skin with foil during resting to preserve crackling texture.
